title: ZAYA1-8B: An 8B Moe Model with 760M Active Params Matching DeepSeek-R1 on Math
summary: ZAYA1-8B is an 8-billion parameter Mixture of Experts (MoE) model that achieves competitive performance with DeepSeek-R1 on math and coding tasks while using only 760M active parameters, making it efficient for deployment.
problem_solved: Provides an efficient open-source math and coding AI model that matches frontier performance with significantly fewer active parameters, reducing computational costs.
why_valuable: democratizes access to high-performance math and coding AI by achieving comparable results to DeepSeek-R1 with a much smaller active parameter footprint.
